contract: A per-model lifetime split names a class only when the member spent in it, out of the FIVE categories the origin serves a daily partition by (input, output, cache-read, cache-write, reasoning — categoryServeOrder in internal/panels/types.go, CATEGORY_KEYS in scripts/capture_usage_series.py, categorySlots in frontend/src/lib/token-usage.ts, held to one list by the capture suite's parity pin): a class the member never spent is ABSENT, never a zero, and a member whose classes sum to nothing never reaches the wire.
